properties.title: Allies fear Trump will target NATO in case of midterm loss
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — NATO countries are bracing for a worst-case scenario in the U.S. midterm elections Tuesday. European allies fear a Republican loss could spur President Donald Trump to dramatically step up his attacks on the alliance, according to five NATO diplomats, all of whom were granted anonymity to speak freely on the sensitive issue. properties.title: Europe Today: Rare Oleshky truce holds in Ukraine, Albania imposes heavy fines on protesters
